passage.text: Today, my family and I went on a day trip to Ayutthaya.
passage.reading: təˈdeɪ, maɪ ˈfæməli ənd ˈaɪ ˈwɛnt ɑːn ə ˈdeɪ ˌtrɪp tu ɑːˈjuːtəjə.

passage.text: We took the train from Bangkok, and it took two hours.
passage.reading: wiː ˈtʊk ðə ˈtreɪn frəm ˈbæŋkɑːk, ənd ɪt ˈtʊk ˈtuː ˈaʊərz.

passage.text: Ayutthaya was the capital of Thailand for more than four hundred years.
passage.reading: ɑːˈjuːtəjə wʌz ðə ˈkæpɪtəl əv ˈtaɪlænd fər ˈmɔːr ðən ˈfɔːr ˈhʌndrəd ˈjɪrz.

passage.text: It had a lot of kings, and it was a big and beautiful city.
passage.reading: ɪt ˈhæd ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈkɪŋz, ənd ɪt wʌz ə ˈbɪɡ ənd ˈbjuːtəfəl ˈsɪti.

passage.text: Now there are a lot of ancient temples there.
passage.reading: ˈnaʊ ðɛr ər ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈeɪnʃənt ˈtɛmpəlz ˈðɛr.

passage.text: We walked around the temples all day and took a lot of photos.
passage.reading: wiː ˈwɔːkt əˈraʊnd ðə ˈtɛmpəlz ˈɔːl ˈdeɪ ənd ˈtʊk ə ˈlɑːt əv ˈfoʊtoʊz.

passage.text: We had noodles for lunch near an old temple.
passage.reading: wiː ˈhæd ˈnuːdəlz fər ˈlʌntʃ ˈnɪr ən ˈoʊld ˈtɛmpəl.

passage.text: I was tired, but it was an amazing day!
passage.reading: aɪ wʌz ˈtaɪərd, bʌt ɪt wʌz ən əˈmeɪzɪŋ ˈdeɪ!
